cases.name: Ruth Esther Reyes de Severino
cases.about: People who knew Reyes described her as a great mother. She was a native of the Dominican Republic who immigrated to the U.S. in 2018, and worked at a restaurant called “La Cuchara.” On her Facebook page, Ruth wrote that she worked as an internist in her native Sabana de la Mar, studied at the UTESA campus in Santo Domingo and psychology at the UASD and graduated from high school at the Virginia Pou high school in her town.
cases.narrative: On 2/5/2020, police found her body, along with the bodies of her daughter and son, in the family's Penns Grove Gardens apartment after they discovered her husband hanging from a tree in a state park forest in the Carneys Position area of ​​New Jersey, near the house where the family lived.
